name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Select two heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, or farmer's walk handles of equal weight.
Stand between the weights with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grasp the weights, keeping your back straight.
Lift the weights by driving through your heels and standing up fully.
Hold the weights at your sides with arms fully extended and shoulders pulled back.
Keep your core tight, chest up, and maintain a neutral spine.
Walk forward with controlled, steady steps for the desired distance or time.
Keep your shoulders level and avoid leaning to either side.
At the end, carefully lower the weights back to the ground with proper form.
